deepdive.divline: - Growth largely fundable via internal cash generation other than hospitality
deepdive.fin_gap: Q4FY26 results are not yet in the structured financials (Financial Scorecard figures not cleanly parseable).

profile.entities: Fratelli Vineyards Ltd (formerly Tinna Trade Ltd); brands: J'NOON, Sette, Fratelli Brut, Shotgun (RTD), NOI Sparkling, Merlot, TiLT (Red/Bubbly Rose), Shiraz Rose; partner: Manish Malhotra (Sette 15th-anniversary collab); moderator Go India Advisors
profile.mgmt: Gaurav Sekhri (Chairman & MD); Aditya Sekhri (Director); Rajesh Garg (CFO); Hemant Arora (Chief Business Officer)
profile.subseg: Premium & luxury still/sparkling wine; RTD (wine-based, "Shotgun"); wine-in-a-can; CSD channel; exports
profile.themes: Premiumization in Indian alco-bev; RTD as fastest-growing alco-bev category; India-EU FTA on wine (>INR2,000 MRP exposure); state excise/regulatory disruption cycle

bull_bear.body:
- Growth largely fundable via internal cash generation other than hospitality.
- As a listed entity, "many tools available" to raise capital if a compelling opportunity arises (no current plan to raise equity/leverage).
- D&A and finance costs rose in FY26 (new assets + borrowings for capacity & working capital).
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- **State excise / regulatory:** primary FY26 headwind — disruptions in Maharashtra, Telangana, Uttarakhand, Delhi; revenue is hostage to state-level license renewals and excise policy changes.
- **Premiumization dependence:** thesis leans heavily on luxury/super-premium and RTD outgrowing premium; any reversal pressures both growth and blended GM.
- **India-EU FTA:** potential competition on >INR2,000 MRP segment (mgmt downplays; <10% of wine revenue there).
- **Weather/agri:** El Nino / rainfall risk to vineyards (mitigated by own vineyards + drip irrigation; full canals post heavy FY25 rain).
- **Execution:** Shotgun doubling, multi-state registrations cyclical (bottleneck on outlet ramp).
bull_bear.title: Risks

bull_bear.body: Confident but measured. Emphasized "inflection point," cost base ready for 2x volume, and disciplined discounting. Repeatedly anchored on the INR240 cr / 30% growth / net-net breakeven FY27 milestone. Guarded on cost-line detail ("sensitive") and on hospitality timing. Credible on regulatory recovery (Telangana +30% post-license renewal evidenced).
bull_bear.title: Management tone

bull_bear.body:
- "Net-net breakeven" (after D&A + finance cost), not just cash/EBITDA breakeven, is the explicit FY27 bar at ~INR240 cr.
- RTD GM (~70%) is dilutive to blended GM as it scales — growth engine slightly trades margin for volume.
- Shotgun launch-year marketing >10% of its own top line; this elevated spend persists ~3 years, a drag on near-term margin even as revenue scales.
- Hospitality (INR70–80 cr) was deferred to prioritize RTD/wine — capital discipline signal, but removes a future revenue/optionality leg from FY27.
- Premium segment (>40% of revenue) actually DECLINED ~15% in FY26 — the flat top line masks a sharp premium contraction offset by luxury (+15%) and RTD (new).
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body:
- **Premium** (>40% of revenue): declined ~15–16% YoY FY26 on regulatory disruptions (Maharashtra, Telangana, Uttarakhand, Delhi); offset partly by Haryana, UP, Kerala, Sikkim.
- **Luxury** (>INR2,000 MRP): +15% YoY; J'NOON +44%; market share >50% in domestic luxury wine.
- **RTD (Shotgun):** ~INR18 cr / ~100,000 cases year 1; market size INR500–600 cr growing ~25% YoY.
- **CSD:** ~8% of revenue, ~45% market share; wine-in-a-can >90% market share in India.
- Premium market share ~30%; HoReCa market share ~40%.
business.title: Segment commentary

business.body:
- ✅ Telangana retail license renewal → Fratelli (Telangana +~30% in Q4; recovery tailwind).
- ⭐ RTD category at ~25% growth (INR500–600 cr market, >1M cases) → Fratelli as wine-based RTD entrant (Shotgun) and >90% wine-in-a-can share.
- (FTA, El Nino: monitored, no clear beneficiary call from mgmt.)

---
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries

latest_quarter.body:
- GM 79% (Q4 & FY26); guided 76–80% as RTD (GM ~70%) scales.
- EBITDA target ~20% (vs current ~breakeven) — to be reached purely via scale/operating leverage; cost base already built to absorb a doubling of business with no major structural change.
- Hospitality explicitly NOT a margin lever; efficiency to come from core wine + RTD scale.
- Discounting/schemes flat over 2–3 years; mgmt now trying to reduce.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost

latest_quarter.body: - **Q4 FY26 (this call):** Rev INR36 cr (+13% YoY); GM 79%; EBITDA −INR3.7 cr (loss halved YoY). FY26: Rev INR184 cr (+1%), EBITDA +INR1 cr (first FY operating breakeven). RTD year 1: ~INR18 cr / ~100k cases. FY27 guidance: +30% rev (~INR240 cr), net-net PAT breakeven, RTD to double. Capex cycle done (~INR9 cr FY27); hospitality (INR70–80 cr) deferred ~1 yr. Luxury +15% (J'NOON +44%); premium −15% on regulatory hits. GM guided 76–80%.
latest_quarter.title: QoQ Log

outlook.body:
- **FY27 revenue growth: ~30%** YoY → implies ~**INR240 cr** revenue.
- **PAT: net-net breakeven (not just cash breakeven) targeted in FY27** at ~INR240 cr revenue.
- Growth visible "even from Q1" of FY27; premiumization momentum continuing into Q1.
- **RTD (Shotgun): double sales in FY27** → cross 200,000 cases (from ~100,000).
- **Exports: target 5% of total revenue from FY27 onwards** (export revenue doubled in FY26).
- **Gross margin: 76%–80%** range going forward (RTD GM ~70% dilutes blended as it scales).
- **Marketing spend: ~7% of sales normal; Shotgun >10% of its top line** (first 3 years on higher side).
- CSD: ~8% of revenue today, expected to grow (Merlot/NOI sales from H1 FY27; Shotgun via CSD H2/Q4 FY27).
outlook.title: Guidance (CRITICAL)

outlook.body:
- RTD (Shotgun) distribution: ~9,000 outlets (2,000 added in FY26); target >15,000 by H2 FY27. Total addressable Fratelli universe ~30,000 outlets.
- Shotgun present in 18 states; FY27 launches planned in Chhattisgarh, Karnataka, Telangana (H1).
- Sette 15th-anniversary limited edition: 5 states now → +7 states FY27 (Delhi, Haryana, UP, WB, TN, Karnataka, Maharashtra).
- Fratelli Brut (launched Nov'25): 4 states → +14 states FY27.
- Exports: 15 countries (bottled, canned, RTD).
outlook.title: Order book / pipeline / distribution

outlook.body:
- RTD as structural second growth driver (wine-based fit, leverages existing infra/distribution); 3 new Shotgun variants in Q1 FY27.
- Wine-in-a-can entering CSD — new channel optionality.
- Hospitality project (INR70–80 cr estimate) — DEFERRED ~1 year; review H2 FY27, possible initiation CY27–28. Optionality, not committed.
- Long-term aspiration: ~INR500 cr revenue by 2030 at ~20% CAGR.
- FTA upside ambiguous — mgmt sees no near-term material impact (90%+ of wine revenue <INR2,000 MRP; RTD unaffected).
outlook.title: Growth / optionality

deepdive.thesis: FY26 was a regulatory-disruption reset year (revenue flat, EBITDA breakeven); FY27 thesis is a 30% growth / net-net PAT-breakeven story powered by a second growth engine (Shotgun RTD doubling) plus continued luxury/super-premium premiumization, with capex cycle largely behind it.

meta.thesis: FY26 was a regulatory-disruption reset year (revenue flat, EBITDA breakeven); FY27 thesis is a 30% growth / net-net PAT-breakeven story powered by a second growth engine (Shotgun RTD doubling) plus continued luxury/super-premium premiumization, with capex cycle largely behind it.
